sections.title: Very short answer questions. Answer in 30–50 words.

questions.q: Write any two advantages of using the paragraph spacing command.
questions.answer: (1) Spacing before and after a paragraph does not change the size of the text, and precise adjustments can be made between headings and body text. (2) If the paragraph is moved or deleted its spacing goes with it, leaving no extra blank lines; spacing can also be included in styles.

questions.q: Explain the purpose of creating envelopes using mail merge.
questions.answer: Envelopes made with mail merge print each recipient's address directly on an envelope from the data source, instead of writing or sticking labels by hand. It saves time and avoids mistakes when many letters must be posted.

questions.q: Write the steps to AutoFit rows (or columns) in a spreadsheet.
questions.answer: (1) Select the row (or column), or a cell in it. (2) Home tab → Format in the Cells group. (3) Click AutoFit Row Height (or AutoFit Column Width). Or double-click the bottom edge of the row header (right edge of the column header).

questions.q: What is a legend in a chart?
questions.answer: A legend is the chart component that shows the colour, symbol or pattern used to mark each data series, so the reader knows which bar, line or slice stands for which data.

questions.q: Name any two views available in PowerPoint and explain briefly.
questions.answer: Normal view — the main working view with slide, outline and notes panes. Slide Sorter view — shows small images of all slides so they can be reordered and transitions added. (Slide Show view shows the presentation full screen to the audience.)

sections.title: Short answer questions. Answer in 50–80 words.

questions.q: Write the main uses of mail merge.
questions.answer: (1) Sending the same letter to many people, each with their own name and address. (2) Inserting variable information in the body of the letter. (3) Printing mailing labels and envelopes, and making directories, invoices and address lists; merged documents can also be e-mailed.

questions.q: Write the steps to protect a worksheet using a password. How do you unprotect it?
questions.answer: Protect: (1) Home tab → Format (Cells group). (2) Choose Protect Sheet. (3) Type a password and click OK. (4) Re-enter the same password to confirm. Now any change shows a warning. Unprotect: Home → Format → Unprotect Sheet → type the same password → OK.

sections.title: Long answer question. Answer in 80–120 words.

questions.q: Explain the SUM, SUMIF, AVERAGE, MAX, MIN and COUNT functions with examples.
questions.answer: SUM adds numbers: =SUM(B2:B6). SUMIF adds cells meeting a condition: =SUMIF(B2:B6, ">50"). AVERAGE gives the arithmetic mean: =AVERAGE(B2:B6). MAX gives the largest value: =MAX(B2:B6). MIN gives the smallest value: =MIN(B2:B6). COUNT counts cells with numbers: =COUNT(B2:B6) (COUNTA counts non-empty cells, COUNTBLANK empty ones, COUNTIF cells meeting a condition). Each function takes up to 255 arguments, written in parentheses after the name, starting with =.
